name: Glass deploy goes live
oneLiner: a deploy card on glass: build, test and deploy nodes spin and land green one by one along a filling track, then the preview URL dot turns green with pulsing rings, the status flips from Deploying to Live and the brand site wipes into the preview frame
say: when the speaker says the site or app went live ('I pushed it and two minutes later it was live', 'it deploys itself'): the steps tick green under the words and the URL turns live on 'live' or 'shipped'
